title: scicodewiki formula registry entry
description: One machine-readable formula claim: SymPy expression + code binding + executable mirror + conventions + references + provenance + verdicts. The equivalence gate derives its check from this record, so the check cannot drift from the formula.

latex.description: optional human textbook form; must round-trip against sympy (v1 check)

formula_impl.description: path (relative to formulas/) of the executable SymPy mirror the gate runs; required for exact/convergent

function.description: function/method name; stable across refactors, unlike line numbers

binds.description: named arrays/lines the formula covers (rendering hints)

symbol_identity.description: human-audit layer: what each symbol/axis physically is; machines do not judge

verified_by.description: link (not dependency) to a test endorsing the mapping

note.description: for oracle/novel: what endorses the claim instead of equivalence

verdicts.description: append-only gate records: audit corpus + badge source + paper evidence chain
